title: 2009 HMMT February General Round 2 Problem 7
statement: Let \(F_{n}\) be the Fibonacci sequence, that is, \(F_{0}=0, F_{1}=1\), and \(F_{n+2}=F_{n+1}+F_{n}\). Compute \(\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} F_{n} / 10^{n}\).

solutions.text: Write \(F(x)=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} F_{n} x^{n}\). Then the Fibonacci recursion tells us that \(F(x)-x F(x)-\) \(x^{2} F(x)=x\), so \(F(x)=x /\left(1-x-x^{2}\right)\). Plugging in \(x=1 / 10\) gives the answer.
